The Router marked this as fully present. artifact_review: The Router identified text gibberish (severity 2) and minor texture fusion (severity 1). I agree with the text assessment; the spines are largely illegible. However, the Router underestimated the severity of the structural artifacts on the lower shelves. The bottom shelf exhibits significant 'melting' where books fuse into the shelf floor and each other, losing all geometric definition. This is more than a texture anomaly; it is a structural collapse of the object class 'book'. The expert topology auditor gave a high confidence score (0.92), but this likely reflects the strong silhouette of the frame, masking the internal semantic failures. The artifact score should be penalized more heavily for this bottom-shelf deformation.
